levels.method: Area-reduced built-up/industrial and woodland coverage from installed IGN district meshes

coverage.scope: IGN FXX modern geographic source, on the continental component of installed physical land inside the finite mainland-France acquisition envelope; Corsica and overseas excluded. Historical sovereignty is unchanged.
coverage.benelux_handoff: Original three-country reference scope handed to installed Benelux context; display only
coverage.geographic_handoff: Installed adjoining source footprints; German and Iberian sources take over built-up and industrial ink only. Display only, not sovereignty.

limits: Modern generalised built-up and woodland reference, not 1900 extent or individual buildings.
Woodland/open ground is not a farm, ownership, yield or economic production statement.
No artificial streets, random houses, population, industry output or transport capacity.
